clues.text: When Noah woke from his drunkenness, he cursed this son of Ham to be a servant of servants.
Abram took Sarai, his nephew Lot and all their possessions and left Haran, setting out for this land.
From the Wilderness of Paran, Moses sent one leader from each tribe to spy out this land.
From Mount Nebo, God told Moses to view this land, which He was giving to the Israelites.
Camped at Gilgal under Joshua, the Israelites saw the manna stop and began eating this land's crops.
When Joseph harshly asked his brothers in Egypt where they came from, they named this land.
In Deborah's day, Jabin reigned in Hazor as king of this land, with Sisera commanding his army.
